integrity: Finite enumeration, signed integral Morse boundary and independent Smith normal form are supplied as executable source files with expected output.
scientific_limitations: A homotopy result for the explicitly defined Clebsch graph and ordinary 3-cut complex only; no general graph family, equivariant equivalence, or independent validation is claimed. Computations require complete acyclic matching and exact integral degree certificates.
title: A Moore-space summand in the ordinary three-cut complex of the Clebsch graph
